name: audit2e crypto getRandomValues ripemd160 aes ctr gcm ecb cbc and cipher errors
source: import * as crypto from "node:crypto"; function main(): void { console.log(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(3)).length, crypto.createHash("ripemd160").update("abc").digest("hex"), crypto.createHash("rmd160").update("").digest("hex")); console.log(crypto.createHmac("ripemd160", "k").update("abc").digest("hex"), crypto.createHash("sha256", { outputLength: 32 }).update("a").digest("hex").length); const key = Buffer.alloc(32, 1), iv = Buffer.alloc(16, 2); const c = crypto.createCipheriv("aes-256-cbc", key, iv); const enc = Buffer.concat([c.update("secret message", "utf8"), c.final()]); console.log(enc.toString("hex")); const d = crypto.createDecipheriv("aes-256-cbc", key, iv); console.log(d.update(enc, undefined, "utf8") + d.final("utf8")); const g = crypto.createCipheriv("aes-128-gcm", Buffer.alloc(16, 3), Buffer.alloc(12, 4)); g.setAAD(Buffer.from("aad")); const ge = Buffer.concat([g.update("gcm text"), g.final()]); const tag = g.getAuthTag(); console.log(ge.toString("hex"), tag.toString("hex")); const gd = crypto.createDecipheriv("aes-128-gcm", Buffer.alloc(16, 3), Buffer.alloc(12, 4)); gd.setAAD(Buffer.from("aad")); gd.setAuthTag(tag); console.log(Buffer.concat([gd.update(ge), gd.final()]).toString()); const ctr = crypto.createCipheriv("aes-128-ctr", Buffer.alloc(16), Buffer.alloc(16)); console.log(Buffer.concat([ctr.update("hello"), ctr.final()]).toString("hex")); const ecb = crypto.createCipheriv("aes-128-ecb", Buffer.alloc(16), null); console.log(Buffer.concat([ecb.update("x"), ecb.final()]).toString("hex")); const bad = crypto.createDecipheriv("aes-256-cbc", key, Buffer.alloc(16, 9)); try { bad.update(enc); bad.final(); } catch (e: any) { console.log(e.code, e.message); } try { crypto.createCipheriv("aes-256-cbc", Buffer.alloc(5), iv); } catch (e: any) { console.log(e.name, e.code, e.message); } try { crypto.createCipheriv("nope", key, iv); } catch (e: any) { console.log(e.name, e.code, e.message); } }
